questions.q: Who met Jim and the gentlemen as they stepped aboard the Hispaniola?
choices: Mr. Arrow, the mate
Captain Smollett
Long John Silver
Tom Morgan, the bosun
questions.evidence: met and saluted as we stepped aboard by the mate, Mr. Arrow

questions.q: What three things did Captain Smollett say he didn't like?
choices: The cruise, the men, and his officer
The ship, the food, and the weather
The squire, the doctor, and Jim
The map, the island, and the gold
questions.evidence: I don't like this cruise; I don't like the men; and I don't like my officer.

questions.q: How did the squire feel during the captain's complaints?
choices: Very angry
Amused and laughing
Frightened
Bored and sleepy
questions.evidence: inquired the squire, very angry, as I could see

questions.q: When the captain says the secret "has been told to the parrot," what does he mean?
choices: The secret has been blabbed to everyone
Silver's parrot can say the word treasure
The secret is written on a bird's leg band
Only one person on board knows it
questions.evidence: "It's a way of speaking," said the captain. "Blabbed, I mean.

questions.q: Why did the captain dislike Mr. Arrow as an officer?
choices: He was too familiar with the crew
He was a poor and careless seaman
He drank too much rum
He was rude to the squire at dinner
questions.evidence: he's too free with the crew to be a good officer

questions.q: Where did the captain want the powder and arms moved?
choices: To the good place under the cabin
To the fore hold, near the men
Onto a shore-boat
Into the galley beside the cook's stove
questions.evidence: you have a good place under the cabin; why not put them there?

questions.q: What did the captain know that shocked the squire?
choices: The exact latitude and longitude of the island
The name of the squire's banker in London
That Silver had once been a pirate
That Pew was dead
questions.evidence: he named the latitude and longitude exactly

questions.q: When the doctor sums up the captain's worries, what does he say the captain really fears?
choices: A mutiny
A storm at sea
Running out of food
Getting lost
questions.evidence: In other words, you fear a mutiny.

questions.q: What did the captain admit he had meant to do when he came into the cabin?
choices: Get himself discharged
Ask the squire for more pay
Steal the map
Fire Mr. Arrow on the spot
questions.evidence: When I came in here I meant to get discharged.

questions.q: Which two men did Dr. Livesey believe were honest?
choices: Captain Smollett and John Silver
Mr. Arrow and Tom Morgan
The squire and Mr. Blandly
Redruth and Hunter
questions.evidence: two honest men on board with you--that man and John Silver

questions.q: What did Long John Silver say when he came aboard and saw the powder being moved?
choices: That they would miss the morning tide
That moving it was a fine idea
That the powder had got wet
That he wanted to help carry it below
questions.evidence: if we do, we'll miss the morning tide!

questions.q: What did the captain do when he saw Jim examining the long brass gun?
choices: Sent him off to the cook to get some work
Showed him how to load and fire it
Praised him for taking such an interest
Had him locked in his cabin for the night
questions.evidence: Off with you to the cook and get some work.

questions.q: How did Jim feel about Captain Smollett at the end of the chapter?
choices: He hated him deeply
He admired him greatly
He felt sorry for him
He didn't care about him
